items.hintCn: 从悬崖跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Jump from the promontory into the circle of lilies.

items.hintCn: 举起小岛上的石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock on this small island.

items.hintCn: 完成方块拼图
items.hintEn: Complete the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 从河南岸出发，跟随花朵
items.hintEn: Start at the south side of the river, and follow the flowers.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 把巨石推进附近的大坑
items.hintEn: Push the boulder into the nearby large hole.

items.hintCn: 跟随空心原木底部开始的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail which starts at the bottom of the hollow log pieces.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 捡起石堆顶部的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock at the top of the rock structure.

items.hintCn: 与桥下的精灵光点互动，用磁力制做安全平台
items.hintEn: Interact with the fairy lights under the bridge. Use Magnesis to make a safe platform.

items.hintCn: 捡起双丘矮峰顶上的孤立石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the solitary rock at the peak of the shorter Dueling Peak.

items.hintCn: 融化冰块，然后查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Melt the block of ice, then examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 用附近的石头补全圆圈
items.hintEn: Use the nearby rock to complete the circle.

items.hintCn: 用磁力移动金属方块匹配附近组合
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to place the metal block to match the nearby set.

items.hintCn: 与精灵光点互动。必须离开初始台地才能获得此种子。位于复苏神庙醒来的水池上方
items.hintEn: Interact with the fairy lights. You must have left the Great Plateau to obtain this seed. This is above the pool you awaken from within the Shrine of Resurrection.

items.hintCn: 捡起这块石头
items.hintEn: Pick up this rock.

items.hintCn: 走到悬崖边（墙后）找大石板。用静止器移动它，然后捡起下面的小石头
items.hintEn: Go to the edge of the cliff (behind the wall) to find the large slab. Move it using Stasis, then pick up the smaller rock under it.

items.hintCn: 查看时之神殿顶部的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Examine the fairy lights at the top of the Temple of Time.

items.hintCn: 查看伐木小屋顶部的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Examine the fairy lights on the top of the Woodcutter's Cabin.

items.hintCn: 用磁力抬起金属门，然后举起下面隐藏的石头。必须获得滑翔伞后才能找到
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to lift the metal door, then lift the rock hidden underneath. This seed is found at the very base of the Great Plateau, so it won't be available until the Paraglider is obtained.

items.hintCn: 用磁力抬起金属门，然后举起下面隐藏的石头
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to lift the metal door, then lift the rock hidden underneath.

items.hintCn: 清理树叶，然后捡起石头
items.hintEn: Clear the leaves, then pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 跟随穿过巨大空心原木的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail through the giant hollow log.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把链球抬进树洞
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to lift the ball on the chain into the hole of the tree trunk.

items.hintCn: 举起两块大石头下面的石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock found underneath two larger rocks.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把方块放到正确位置。位于悬崖壁架上
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to put the block in the correct place. Located on a cliff ledge.

items.hintCn: 把椰子放进空篮子
items.hintEn: Place a palm fruit in the empty basket.

items.hintCn: 把苹果放进空篮子
items.hintEn: Place an apple in the empty basket.

items.hintCn: 炸碎巨石，捡起下面的石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the boulders and pick up the rock underneath.

items.hintCn: 爬到山顶举起孤立的石头。建议耐寒等级1
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the hill and lift up the solitary rock. Level 1 cold resistance recommended.

items.hintCn: 从东北高原搬一块石头上来补全石圈。可以从西南边缘跳上平台
items.hintEn: Grab a rock from the plateau to the northeast, and get it up to and complete the rock circle. You can jump up onto the platform from the southwestern edge.

items.hintCn: 用磁力抬起链球放进空心树桩
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to lift the ball-and-chain and put it into the hollow stump.

items.hintCn: 融化冰块查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Melt the ice and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 爬到山顶举起小石头
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the hill and lift the small rock.

items.hintCn: 射气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 举起树上的石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock in the tree.

items.hintCn: 站在树桩上，射飞起来的橡果
items.hintEn: Stand on the stump, and shoot the flying acorns.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 解开磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 爬到旗杆顶，查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the flag pole, then examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 从西北三大悬崖之间出发，跟随花朵
items.hintEn: Start between the three large cliffs to the northwest, and follow the flowers.

items.hintCn: 把石头扔进石圈。必须获得滑翔伞后才能找到
items.hintEn: Throw a rock into the circle of rocks. This seed belongs to the Great Plateau Tower Region, but won't be available until the Paraglider is obtained.

items.hintCn: 在卓拉领地顶部鱼雕像的'喷水口'处查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: In the 'spout' of the fish statue on top of Zora's Domain, examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 把苹果放进空供碗
items.hintEn: Place an apple in the empty offering bowl.

items.hintCn: 从石桥顶出发，沿桥下绕一圈追花径
items.hintEn: Start on top of the rock bridge and chase the flower trail by climbing down and around under the bridge.

items.hintCn: 烧掉或砍掉枯叶，然后举起小石头
items.hintEn: Burn or cut away the dead leaves and then lift up the small rock.

items.hintCn: 放苹果
items.hintEn: Place apple.

items.hintCn: 烧掉树叶，捡起露出的石头
items.hintEn: Burn the leaves and pick up the revealed rock.

items.hintCn: 把苹果放进空篮子
items.hintEn: Place an apple in the empty basket.

items.hintCn: 把巨石从小塔上推到下方的凹槽里
items.hintEn: Push the boulder off the small tower into the indented hole below.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock up.

items.hintCn: 查看技术实验室顶部旋转的树叶
items.hintEn: Examine the swirling leaves at the top of the Tech Lab.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球。第三个气球在你身后藏在原木里
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the balloons. The third balloon is behind you, hidden in the log.

items.hintCn: 捡起树桩里的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock in the stump.

items.hintCn: 爬上哈特诺古代研究所顶部的守护者。从断腿处爬最容易
items.hintEn: Climb atop the guardian found at the top of the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab. The easiest place to climb up is the broken guardian's leg.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射五个气球靶
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot all five balloon targets.

items.hintCn: 捡起金属方块放回正确位置
items.hintEn: Pick up the metal cube and place it back into its correct spot.

items.hintCn: 跟随长长的黄色花径到山顶。花径起点在图中位置，在山周围地面上稍西北
items.hintEn: Follow the long yellow flower trail to the top of the hill. The start of the trail is pictured here and begins a bit north west of the location on the ground around the hill.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射三个气球靶
items.hintEn: Stand next to the pinwheel and shoot the three balloon targets.

items.hintCn: 爬上石墙站在风车旁。两个橡果会从树梢上方飞过。小心瞄准射箭。可以用静止器
items.hintEn: Climb on top of the stone wall and stand next to the pinwheel. Two acorns will fly above the treetops. Carefully aim and destroy them with arrows. You can use Stasis on the acorns to help you.

items.hintCn: 从悬崖跳下或跳入下方水中的花圈
items.hintEn: Jump or dive into the ring of flowers in the water below the cliff.

items.hintCn: 从桥上在石圈正前方造冰柱，然后把石头扔到冰柱上弹进圈里
items.hintEn: From the bridge above, put a Cryonis pillar just in front of the circle of rocks, then toss a rock onto the pillar so it bounces into the circle.

items.hintCn: 点燃这里的两个火炬
items.hintEn: Light the two torches up here.

items.hintCn: 跳下或跳入花圈。可以从海拉鲁桥顶滑翔或造冰柱
items.hintEn: Jump or dive into the ring of flowers. You can glide from the top of the Hylia bridge or use a cryonis pillar.

items.hintCn: 移动金属方块使两组图案完全相同
items.hintEn: Move the metal block to match both sets identically.

items.hintCn: 把巨石扔进河里的石圈
items.hintEn: Throw a boulder into the ring of rocks in the river.

items.hintCn: 举起弗罗里亚山顶的石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock found at the top of Mount Floria.

items.hintCn: 把苹果丢进空供碗
items.hintEn: Drop an apple into the empty offering bowl.

items.hintCn: 游到湖中小岛，举起顶上的小石头
items.hintEn: Swim to the small island in the lake and lift the small rock on top.

items.hintCn: 捡起这块石头
items.hintEn: Pick up this rock.

items.hintCn: 在两座雕像后面调查
items.hintEn: Investigate behind the two statues.

items.hintCn: 查看喷泉顶部的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Examine the fairy lights at the top of the fountain.

items.hintCn: 查看尖塔顶部的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Examine the fairy lights at the top of the spire.

items.hintCn: 爬到瀑布柱最顶端查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb to the very top of the waterfall pillar and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 解开磁力方块拼图。方块在亭子上方
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle. The block is above the pavilion.

items.hintCn: 解开磁力方块拼图。方块在上方木平台上
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle. The block is on the wooden platform above.

items.hintCn: 这里有两个精灵光点在飞舞。两个都抓可得两个种子
items.hintEn: There are two fairy lights dancing around here. Catch them both for two seeds.

items.hintCn: 融化冰块。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Melt the block of ice. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 融化冰块。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Melt the block of ice. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射三个橡果。可以用静止器辅助
items.hintEn: Stand next to the pinwheel, shoot the three acorns. You can use stasis to make it easier.

items.hintCn: 抓住绕区域盘旋的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights circling the area.

items.hintCn: 悬崖边有金属方块。把缺失的方块放回正确位置使一切匹配
items.hintEn: On the cliffside there are some metal cubes. Put the missing cube back into the correct spot to make everything match.

items.hintCn: 这个种子的花径从南边东面崖壁开始。跟随花朵找种子
items.hintEn: The flower trail to this seed starts to the south, on the eastern cliff face. Follow the flowers to the seed.

items.hintCn: 这个赛跑起点平台在东南远处，卡奥·玛卡神庙上方峰顶。赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: This race platform starts far to the southeast, on the peak above the Ka'o Makagh Shrine. Race to the ring for the seed.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射头顶盘旋的五个气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the five balloons circling overhead.

items.hintCn: 两座遗迹并排。北边多一块石头，南边缺一块。把多余的搬到缺失处
items.hintEn: There are two ruins side by side. The one to the north has an extra rock, the one to the south is missing a rock. Carry the extra to the missing spot for the seed.

items.hintCn: 用石头补全圆圈
items.hintEn: Use the rock to complete the circle.

items.hintCn: 到达小岛时花径就开始
items.hintEn: The flower trail for this begins as you reach the island.

items.hintCn: 站在附近神庙的种子平台上。限时到达东边小岛
items.hintEn: Stand on the seed platform at the nearby shrine. Within the timer, reach the tiny island east of there.

items.hintCn: 把小石头扔进水里的石圈。造冰柱可以更容易到达
items.hintEn: Throw a small rock into the ring of rocks found in the water. Cryonis can make it easier to reach.

items.hintCn: 举起溪边的小石头
items.hintEn: Lift up the small rock found at the edge of the creek.

items.hintCn: 在这个山洞里，按花数数到5
items.hintEn: In a cave in this hill, count to 5 using the flowers.

items.hintCn: 用附近三块石头补全石圈
items.hintEn: Complete the circle of rocks using three nearby rocks.

items.hintCn: 推巨石使其滚进坑里
items.hintEn: Push the boulder so it rolls into the hole.

items.hintCn: 捡起这块石头
items.hintEn: Pick up this rock.

items.hintCn: 抓住绕遗迹跑的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights that run around the ruins.

items.hintCn: 看桥下，捡起石头
items.hintEn: Look under the bridge, and pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock.

items.hintCn: 爬旗杆，查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb the flag pole, then examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 爬到西北石柱顶找种子平台。滑翔到圆环别超时
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the stone pillar northwest of here to find the seed platform. Glide to the ring before the time runs out.

items.hintCn: 移开大巨石，然后举起小石头
items.hintEn: Remove the big boulder and then lift the smaller rock.

items.hintCn: 在桥下射悬挂的橡果
items.hintEn: Under the bridge, shoot the hanging acorn.

items.hintCn: 把磁力石头放进井里
items.hintEn: Put the magnetic rock in the well.

items.hintCn: 站在树桩上看它后面的大树。会看到两个靶子在树后抛起。小心瞄准射箭
items.hintEn: Stand on the stump and look at the large tree behind it. You will see two targets being tossed up behind the tree. Aim carefully and you can hit them with arrows.

items.hintCn: 在西山顶上，把巨石滚进坑里
items.hintEn: At the top of the hill to the west, roll the boulder down into the hole.

items.hintCn: 炸碎巨石，捡起下面的石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the boulders and pick up the rock under them.

items.hintCn: 连续跳三个栅栏。也可以用摩托 zero jump
items.hintEn: Jump all three fences in a row. This can also be done with the Master Cycle Zero using the Zero Jump.

items.hintCn: 跟随绕区域一圈的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail in a little circle around the area.

items.hintCn: 站在树桩上射三个气球
items.hintEn: Stand on the stump and shoot the three balloons.

items.hintCn: 举起岩顶上的石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock on top of the rock formation.

items.hintCn: 跳进睡莲
items.hintEn: Jump into lilies.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 射原木里的橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn in the log.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 捡起斗技场顶层的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock on the top floor of the Coliseum.

items.hintCn: 追精灵光点并查看
items.hintEn: Chase the fairy lights and examine them.

items.hintCn: 从被瘴气包围的树开始赛跑，爬到岩石点
items.hintEn: Race from the tree surrounded by Malice goo and climb up to the rock point.

items.hintCn: 射桥下悬挂的橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn hanging under the bridge.

items.hintCn: 藏在棕榈树旁小石头下
items.hintEn: Hidden underneath the small rock near the palm tree.

items.hintCn: 悬崖半腰有个小石架带块石头。捡起
items.hintEn: Halfway down the cliff there is a tiny ledge with a rock. Pick it up.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the cube puzzle.

items.hintCn: 完成石圈
items.hintEn: Complete the rock circle.

items.hintCn: 把石头扔进圆圈。可能需要在冰柱上滑过去
items.hintEn: Throw a rock into the circle. You may have to slide the rock over a cryonis block.

items.hintCn: 把石头扔进石圈。用造冰术帮助够距离
items.hintEn: Throw a rock into the circle of rocks. Use Cryonis to help cover the distance.

items.hintCn: 把球放进树桩
items.hintEn: Put the ball into the stump.

items.hintCn: 射橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn.

items.hintCn: 捡起干涸井里的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock in the dried up well.

items.hintCn: 跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Dive into the circle of lilies.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图。方块在水里
items.hintEn: Solve the cube puzzle. The cube is in the water.

items.hintCn: 捡起独立墙上的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock on a standalone wall.

items.hintCn: 跟随东北树桩开始的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail that starts on a stump to the northeast.

items.hintCn: 把金属石头放进树桩的洞里
items.hintEn: Put the metal rock in the hole in the stump.

items.hintCn: 爬大树，捡起顶上的石头
items.hintEn: Climb the thick tree, and pick up the rock on top.

items.hintCn: 爬树，举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the tree, lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 把苹果丢进空供碗
items.hintEn: Drop an apple into the empty offering bowl.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the stone.

items.hintCn: 移动大石板，然后举起下面的小石头
items.hintEn: Move the large slab, then lift the small rock underneath.

items.hintCn: 用同崖壁上的石头补全圆圈
items.hintEn: Complete the circle with a rock found on the same cliffside.

items.hintCn: 在可炸墙后的山洞里举起石头
items.hintEn: Inside of a cave behind a bombable wall, lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 爬到山顶举起小石头
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of this mountain and lift up the small rock.

items.hintCn: 从左边树上摘掉苹果使其和右边两棵一样
items.hintEn: Remove apples from the tree on the left until it looks like the two on the right.

items.hintCn: 举起峰顶小石头。建议耐寒等级1
items.hintEn: Lift the small rock at the top of the peak. Cold Resistance Level 1 recommended.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 举起毒沼中央小岛上的石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock on the small island at the center of the poisonous bog.

items.hintCn: 供奉一颗榴莲
items.hintEn: Offer a Hearty Durian.

items.hintCn: 把石头扔进突出岩石的中心
items.hintEn: Throw a rock into the center of the protruding rocks.

items.hintCn: 射桥下的气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon that's underneath the bridge.

items.hintCn: 炸碎石堆，捡起下面的石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the rock pile and pick up the rock underneath.

items.hintCn: 用磁力从雕像右手的方块拼图抓铁块搬到左手
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to grab the iron cube from the block puzzle on the east hand of the statue and take it to the west hand.

items.hintCn: 按顺序1到5访问每组花
items.hintEn: Visit each group of flowers in order, 1 through 5.

items.hintCn: 射气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 完成石螺旋
items.hintEn: Complete the rock spiral.

items.hintCn: 炸墙捡起石头
items.hintEn: Bomb the wall and pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 完成石圈。石头在圆圈缺口方向（北）
items.hintEn: Complete the rock circle. The rock is in the direction of the gap in the circle, to the north.

items.hintCn: 从西边石圈中心搬巨石，放到空位
items.hintEn: Grab the boulder at the center of the rock ring west of here, and place it in the empty spot.

items.hintCn: 站在北端桥边。把巨石扔下水中石圈
items.hintEn: Stand on the edge of the bridge at the north end. Toss a boulder down into the ring of rocks in the water below.

items.hintCn: 站在瀑布底的种子平台上，穿卓拉铠甲游上瀑布
items.hintEn: Stand on the seed platform at the base of the waterfall, then swim up the waterfall using Zora Armor.

items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintEn: Solve the large Magnesis Block puzzle.

items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle.

items.hintEn: Climb the pillar and pick up the rock.

items.hintEn: Roll a large boulder into the hole. The Stasis rune may help if the boulder misses the mark.

items.hintEn: Lift the big rock (using Stasis or an Octo Balloon), and then pick up the small rock under it.

items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot down all three balloon targets.

items.hintEn: Pick up the rock found underneath the bridge.

items.hintEn: Fill in all three missing spots in the ring of rocks.

items.hintEn: At water level, in the cave, drop an apple into the offering bowl.

items.hintEn: Follow the yellow flower trail up the hill.

items.hintEn: Shoot this emblem.

items.hintEn: On the upper ledge, lift this rock.

items.hintCn: 爬上石柱空心顶，在雕像旁空篮子里放苹果
items.hintEn: Climb up into the hollow top of the stone pillar and place an apple in the empty basket by the statue.

items.hintCn: 射瓦·梅多旁边心形开口里的气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon in the heart shaped opening next to vah medoh.

items.hintCn: 爬到这里最高的树顶
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the tallest tree here.

items.hintCn: 爬到顶举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb to the top, and lift up the rock.

items.hintCn: 爬到顶举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb to the top, and lift up the rock.

items.hintCn: 两棵树只有一个苹果，让第三棵和它们一样
items.hintEn: Two of these trees have only one apple, make the third look like them.

items.hintCn: 跳！
items.hintEn: Geronimo.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在东边深渊上方木平台上，然后赛跑取种子。圆环消失很快，建议先存档。加速辅助，跳下平台，少滑翔（滑翔费时最远），冲刺到圆环
items.hintEn: Climb up to the seed platform on the wood platform high above the chasm to the east, then race to the seed. The ring disappears quickly, so save before you attempt it. Speed boosts help, run off the platform, paraglide very little (gliding spends the most time while covering the least distance and height), then sprint to the circle.

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚进坑里
items.hintEn: Roll the boulder into the hole.

items.hintCn: 爬到双马驿站顶，查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of Dueling Peaks Stable, then examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 爬树，举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the tree, lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 解开简单方块拼图取种子
items.hintEn: Solve the simple block puzzle for the seed.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射北边附近树上方抛起的橡果
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot acorns that get thrown up above the nearby tree to the north.

items.hintCn: 捡起这里的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock here.

items.hintCn: 爬上这个壁架，举起这块石头
items.hintEn: Climb up to this ledge, and lift this rock.

items.hintCn: 爬树，举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb up the tree, lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚过两棵树。巨石可在西边坡上找到
items.hintEn: Roll a boulder through the two trees. Some boulders can be found uphill to the west.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把铁块移到正确位置
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to move the iron cube into the correct spot.

items.hintCn: 把可用石头之一扔进圆圈中心。用造冰术辅助
items.hintEn: Throw one of the many available rocks into the center of the circle. Use Cryonis Rune to help.

items.hintCn: 在树洞找橡果射掉
items.hintEn: Find the acorn in a hole in a tree and shoot it.

items.hintCn: 用附近石头补全星形石图案
items.hintEn: Complete the star-shaped stone pattern with a nearby rock.

items.hintCn: 滚开这块巨石，然后举起露出的石头
items.hintEn: Roll this boulder away and then lift the uncovered rock.

items.hintCn: 抓住悬垂下方的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights below the overhang.

items.hintCn: 这个方块拼图一半在水下。解开它
items.hintEn: Half this block puzzle is underwater. Solve it.

items.hintCn: 完成方块拼图
items.hintEn: Complete the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁触发气球。用定时炸弹比射箭更容易
items.hintEn: Stand next to the pinwheel to trigger a balloon. A well timed bomb will make this balloon much easier than attempting to shoot it with arrows.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在东南壁架上。赛跑至敌营顶圆环
items.hintEn: The seed platform is on a ledge to the southeast. Race to the ring at the top of the enemy encampment.

items.hintCn: 给缺一个的供碗供奉苹果
items.hintEn: Offer an apple to the offering bowl that's missing one.

items.hintCn: 完成X形拼图所需的石头藏在东边附近灌木丛里。用斩草武器更容易找
items.hintEn: The rock needed to complete this x-shaped puzzle is hidden in a nearby bush to the east. If you have a weapon that cuts grass/bushes, this will make it much easier to find.

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚进坑里
items.hintEn: Roll the boulder into the hole.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 这块石头周围水里有方形金属块阵列。一块放错了。用造冰术到达，磁力移动归位
items.hintEn: Surrounding this rock are a square pattern of large metal cubes in the water . One is out of place. Use Cryonis to reach it, and Magnesis to move it into place.

items.hintCn: 捡起断柱遗迹上的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock at the ruins of the broken pillar.

items.hintCn: 东南坡上有个盾滑商人。树上方是赛跑种子平台。盾滑到标记取种子
items.hintEn: Uphill to the southeast is a shield vendor who talks about shield surfing. This should be a hint. In the tree above him is the seed platform to start the race. Shield surf down to the marker for your seed.

items.hintCn: 跟随断柱边的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail down the side of the broken pillar.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在西南死守护者旁。赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: The seed platform is to the southwest next to a dead guardian. Race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 射空心原木里的橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn tucked inside this hollow log.

items.hintCn: 跟随黄色花径。起点在终点标记稍西北的小山上。注意终点前最后一朵黄花藏在悬崖边
items.hintEn: Follow the yellow flower trail. It begins on the hill just northwest of the end mark. Note that the final yellow flower before the end hides on the edge of the cliff.

items.hintCn: 跟随西边柱子开始的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail that starts on the pillar to the west.

items.hintCn: 三个大石圈里套小石圈。把南边大圈三块巨石间的散石放到北边大圈最小石圈中心
items.hintEn: There are three very large rock circles, with smaller circles of rocks within them. Take the stray rock from between the 3 large boulders in the southern huge circle, and put it in the middle of the smallest circle of rocks in the northern huge circle.

items.hintCn: 举起可炸石后面隐藏的石头
items.hintEn: Lift the stone hidden behind the bombable rocks.

items.hintCn: 举起铁球放进井里
items.hintEn: Lift up the iron ball and put it into the well.

items.hintCn: 追抓绕池塘盘旋的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Chase and catch the fairy lights circling the pond.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图。方块在西边坡下
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle. The block is downhill to the west.

items.hintCn: 解开磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 这个赛跑的种子平台在北边更大高原上
items.hintEn: The seed platform for this race is on the larger plateau to the north.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 融化冰块
items.hintEn: Melt the ice.

items.hintCn: 跟随穿过肋骨的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail across the ribs.

items.hintEn: This flower trail goes back and forth to the various rocks in the area.

items.hintEn: One cactus has too many voltfruit. Make it look like the other two.

items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail across the ribs.

items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 从果实过多的仙人掌上摘果使其匹配
items.hintEn: Remove fruit from the cactus with extra until it matches.

items.hintCn: 用磁力抬起金属门，再用肌肉举起小石头
items.hintEn: Lift the metal door with Magnesis, then the little rock with your bulging muscles.

items.hintCn: 炸碎神庙入口顶裂纹巨石，举起下面隐藏的小石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the cracked boulders on top of the temple entrance and lift up the small rock hidden underneath.

items.hintCn: 用磁力移开金属门，举起下面隐藏的小石头
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to move the metal door away, then lift up the small rock hidden underneath.

items.hintCn: 柱子顶上石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock on top of the pillar.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot all three balloon targets.

items.hintEn: Jump or dive into the ring of flowers in the water.

items.hintEn: Lift the rock.

items.hintEn: Run through the yellow flower patches in order from 1 to 5. Patch 5 is in the tree behind patch 4.

items.hintCn: 从苹果过多的树上摘果使其和另外两棵一样
items.hintEn: Remove apples from the tree with too many until it looks like the other two.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把链上金属巨石抬到石柱中心
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to lift the chained metal boulder into the center of the stone pillars.

items.hintCn: 北瀑布半腰有个壁架带块石头。捡起
items.hintEn: Halfway down the northern waterfall there's a ledge with a rock. Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 融化冰块
items.hintEn: Melt the ice.

items.hintCn: 爬柱子捡起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the pillar, pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在东边树上。赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: The seed platform is on the tree just to the east. Race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 爬上北边种子平台，然后赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: Climb up to the seed platform a short bit to the north, then race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 在雕像旁空篮子里放苹果使两篮匹配
items.hintEn: Put an apple in the empty basket near the statue so that both baskets match.

items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle. The block you need is in the lake.

items.hintCn: 跳入或跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Jump/dive into the ring of water lilies.

items.hintCn: 花径从西边树桩开始
items.hintEn: The flower trail starts in the stump to the west.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 这条花径第一朵在呜·洛塔神庙位置东南，刚过树
items.hintEn: The first flower in this trail is southeast of the Voo Lota Shrine location, just past the tree.

items.hintCn: 树叶堆下石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock under a pile of leaves.

items.hintEn: Complete the stone circle.

items.hintEn: Dive or jump into the circle of water lilies.

items.hintEn: Stand on the seed platform found on the large cliff southwest of here (jutting out from the eastern cliff face), and then race to the ring before the time runs out.

items.hintCn: 抓住绕区域跑的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights that run around in the area.

items.hintCn: 用磁力解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the block-puzzle by using Magnesis.

items.hintCn: 把石头扔进池塘石圈
items.hintEn: Throw a rock into the circle of rocks in the pond.

items.hintCn: 把两块磁力石头放进两个空心树桩
items.hintEn: Put two magnetic rocks into two hollowed out tree stumps.

items.hintCn: 按从少到多顺序跑过每束花。要到荆棘围空心树内第四束，可以烧掉荆棘或从附近树滑翔下去
items.hintEn: Run through each of the flower bunches in order from least to most. To reach the fourth flower bunch inside the hollow tree surrounded by thorns you can burn away the thorns, or glide down from a nearby tree.

items.hintCn: 炸碎巨石，捡起石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the boulders, pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 完成石圈
items.hintEn: Complete the circle of rocks.

items.hintCn: 爬上神庙旁空心树桩里的枯树。顶上查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb up the dead tree in in the hollow stump next to the shrine. Examine the fairy lights at the top.

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚进下方池塘
items.hintEn: Roll a boulder into the pond below.

items.hintCn: 在西端波克布林营地下面找小石头。搬到石圈放下露出克洛格
items.hintEn: Find a nearby small rock just to the west underneath a Bokoblin camp. Bring it over to the stone circle and drop it in place to reveal the Korok.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在西南，横跨道路的高大石柱拱顶。赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: The seed platform is to the southwest, at the top of the tall rock pillar arching over the road. Race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 跳入下方圆圈
items.hintEn: Dive into the circle below.

items.hintCn: 用磁力移动附近破屋金属方块。匹配方块拼图图案
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis on the metal cube that's in the nearby broken down house. Match the box puzzle, making the patterns identical.

items.hintCn: 瘴气区后石头底下。射眼睛清瘴气
items.hintEn: Under a rock behind corrupted area. Shoot the eye to clear the Malice.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图。方块在水里
items.hintEn: Solve the cube puzzle. The cube is in the water.

items.hintCn: 解开磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 解开磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 爬格鲁德驿站旁细石柱，举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the thin rock pillar next to Gerudo Stables, and lift the rock.

items.hintEn: Lift up the small rock.

items.hintCn: 射悬挂的橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the hanging acorn.

items.hintEn: Put a rock in the middle of the stone rings.

items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to put the iron ball in the treestump.

items.hintCn: 给所有缺的供碗放苹果
items.hintEn: Put apples in all offering bowls that are missing one.

items.hintCn: 石柱顶石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock on top of a stone pillar.

items.hintCn: 按1到5跑过花丛
items.hintEn: Run through the patches of flowers 1-5.

items.hintCn: 完成石圈
items.hintEn: Complete the circle of rocks.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under the rock.

items.hintCn: 跳入或跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Dive/jump into the circle of water lilies.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射下五个气球靶
items.hintEn: Stand next to the pinwheel and shoot down all five balloon targets.

items.hintCn: 在洞壁悬垂下方，给剩余碗里放苹果
items.hintEn: Under the overhang in the cave, fill the remaining bowls with an apple.

items.hintCn: 完成石圈。石头在缺口方向（西）
items.hintEn: Complete the rock circle. The rock is in the direction of the open gap (west).

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 从井口上射树后飞过的气球
items.hintEn: From on top of the well, shoot the balloons as they fly behind the trees.

items.hintCn: 方块拼图。用磁力移动金属箱使两图案相同
items.hintEn: Box Puzzle. Make the two patterns identical using Magnesis on the metal box.

items.hintCn: 跟随穿过石桥的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the trail of flowers across the stone crossing.

items.hintCn: 正北方两悬崖间有巨石。沿小峡谷滚一块进坑里
items.hintEn: Directly to the north, wedged between two cliffs are some boulders. Roll one of them down the small ravine and into the hole.

items.hintCn: 爬树捡起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the tree, pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 把石头扔进石圈
items.hintEn: Throw a rock into the circle of rocks.

items.hintCn: 爬树，举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the tree, lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁，射附近飞橡果
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel, shoot the nearby flying acorns.

items.hintCn: 爬树，举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the tree, lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 爬最高的树查看顶部精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb the tallest tree and examine the fairy lights at the top.

items.hintCn: 一棵苹果树太多苹果。让它和其他一样
items.hintEn: One tree has too many apples. Make it look like the others.

items.hintCn: 树叶堆下石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock under a pile of leaves.

items.hintCn: 把苹果丢进供碗
items.hintEn: Drop an apple in the offering bowl.

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚进坑里。巨石在东南坡上
items.hintEn: Bowl the boulder into the hole. The boulder is uphill to the southeast.

items.hintCn: 融化冰块。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Melt the block of ice. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 把中心巨石推到该在的地方
items.hintEn: Push the center boulder to where it belongs.

items.hintCn: 种子从本位置东边峰顶树旁种子平台开始。开始赛跑，快速滑翔爬到更近的树。爬到树顶再滑翔到圆环取种子。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: This seed starts at a seed platform next to the tree on the peak to the east of this location. Start the race, then quickly glide and climb over to the closer tree. Climb to the very top of this tree, and then glide to the ring to get the seed. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 把石头放进缺口补全圆圈。需要的石头在西北
items.hintEn: Put a rock in the gap to finish the circle. The rock you need is to the northwest.

items.hintCn: 小屋顶上精灵光点
items.hintEn: Fairy lights on top of the hut.

items.hintCn: 爬到湖中心树顶捡起石头
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the tree in the middle of the lake, and pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 站在叶树桩（北偏东）上，限时赛跑至圆环。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Stand on the leaf stump (located north and slightly east), and then race to the circle before time runs out. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 跳下或跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Jump or dive into the circle of water lilies.

items.hintCn: 放石头补全圆圈。需要的石头在东边
items.hintEn: Place a rock to finish the circle. The rock you need is to the east.

items.hintCn: 在最东雕像底部叶子上放榴莲
items.hintEn: Place a Hearty Durian in the leaf at the base of the easternmost statue.

items.hintCn: 捡起死守护者堆旁的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock near the pile of dead guardians.

items.hintCn: 跳下或跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Jump or dive into the circle of water lilies.

items.hintCn: 炸碎巨石，捡起小石头
items.hintEn: Blast the boulders then pick up the small rock.

items.hintCn: 精灵光点绕区域盘旋。抓住。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Fairy Lights are circling the location. Catch them. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Jump into the ring of water lilies.

items.hintCn: 爬小柱子捡起小石头
items.hintEn: Climb the small pillar, pick up the small rock.

items.hintCn: 捡起崖下木平台上的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock on the wooden platform just down the cliff.

items.hintCn: 花径从山西南侧开始。跟随到峰顶
items.hintEn: The flower trail starts on the southwest side of the hill. Follow it to the peak.

items.hintCn: 这条长花径从西南山顶全程开始。具体从山顶遗迹断梯尽头开始
items.hintEn: This long distance flower trail starts all the way at the top of the hill to the southwest. Specifically beginning at the end of the broken staircase in the ruins on top of the hill.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图。方块在西边遗迹顶
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle. The cube is located on top of the ruins to the west.

items.hintCn: 站种子平台激活计时，快速赛跑至双斜柱顶跳下，别超时
items.hintEn: Activate the timer by standing on the seed platform, then quickly race to the top of the two angled pillars and jump off before the time runs out.

items.hintCn: 在城堡墙远端找风车。射五个气球露出克洛格
items.hintEn: Find the pinwheel on the far end of the castle wall. Shoot five balloons to reveal the Korok.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在圣所阳台。限时到尖塔
items.hintEn: The seed platform is on the Sanctum balcony. Reach the spire before time runs out.

items.hintCn: 在城堡顶塔里，射藏在钟上方的气球
items.hintEn: In the tower at the top of the castle, shoot the balloon hiding above the bell.

items.hintCn: 爬到城堡最尖顶查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb the castle to the very top of the spire and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 爬到第二门屋顶尖塔顶
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the spire on the roof of the Second Gatehouse.

items.hintCn: 从外面进餐厅，走到另一头走廊。沿左墙找下个房间前走廊里可炸墙。炸开，射持锈剑雕像上方悬挂的橡果露出克洛格
items.hintEn: From outside, head through the Dining Hall and into the corridor on the other side. From there, follow the left wall to find a bombable wall in a corridor before the next room. Break it and shoot the acorn hanging above the statue holding the Rusty Claymore, to reveal a Korok.

items.hintCn: 炸墙露出石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the wall to reveal the rock.

items.hintCn: 按花的顺序。第一朵花在两丛花旁的死守护者上
items.hintEn: Follow the order of the flowers. The first flower is on the dead guardian next to the group of two flowers.

items.hintCn: 用东边水下方块完成磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Finish the magnetic block puzzle with the block submerged to the east.

items.hintCn: 放石头补全圆圈。需要的石头东边裸树旁，用静止器辅助找。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Place a rock to complete the circle. The rock you need is to the east by some bare trees; use Stasis to help you find it. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 石桥支架旁有个气球。射它取种子
items.hintEn: A balloon is next to some of the supports for the rock bridge. Shoot it to get the seed.

items.hintCn: 按顺序跑花
items.hintEn: Run through the flowers in order.

items.hintCn: 用附近石头补全圆圈
items.hintEn: Use the nearby rock to complete the circle.

items.hintCn: 赛跑从种子位置西边开始。面向附近神庙从右边雪路上爬一段找种子平台开始赛跑
items.hintEn: The race starts west of the seed's location. You can face the nearby shrine and climb the snow path to the right up a ways to find the seed platform which starts the race.

items.hintCn: 爬树，举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the tree, lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Jump into the ring of water lilies.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把铁巨石移进挖空树桩
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to move the iron boulder into the dug out tree stump.

items.hintCn: 跳、潜或跌入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Jump, dive, or fall into the ring of water lilies.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under the rock.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把链上石头移进树桩
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to move the chained rock into the stump.

items.hintCn: 种子在遗迹中间金属门下
items.hintEn: Seed is under a metal door in the middle of some ruins.

items.hintCn: 这个种子的花径从正西山顶开始。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: The flower trail to this seed starts at the top of the hill directly to the west. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 跳下或跳入水中睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Jump or dive into the circle of lilies in the water.

items.hintCn: 这条短花径在去种子的海岸边开始
items.hintEn: This short flower trail begins on the coast on the way to the seed.

items.hintCn: 跳入漂浮海藻圈
items.hintEn: Dive into the circle of floating seaweed.

items.hintCn: 丢石头补全圆圈。石头在开阔处方向（西南）坡下
items.hintEn: Drop a rock to complete the circle. The rock is downhill in the direction of the open spot (southwest).

items.hintCn: 崖顶稍下有个小石架带块石头。捡起
items.hintEn: Just below the top of the cliff is a small ledge with a rock. Pick it up.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 可碎石后石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock behind some destructible rocks.

items.hintCn: 从南边坡上滚巨石进挖空坑
items.hintEn: Roll a giant boulder from uphill to the south down into the dug out pit.

items.hintCn: 从苹果过多的树上摘果使其和另外两棵一样
items.hintEn: Remove apples from the tree with many to have it match the other two.

items.hintCn: 完成螺旋石图案
items.hintEn: Complete the spiral rock pattern.

items.hintCn: 射树干里藏的橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn hidden in the tree trunk.

items.hintCn: 捡起这块石头
items.hintEn: Pick up this rock.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under the rock.

items.hintCn: 跳或跌入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Jump or fall into the ring of water lilies.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射三个气球。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Stand next to the pinwheel and shoot the three balloons. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended

items.hintCn: 其中一棵树苹果太多。摘到和另外两棵一样
items.hintEn: One of the trees has too many apples. Remove them until it matches the other two.

items.hintCn: 射树上的橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn in the tree.

items.hintCn: 附近土路绕一圈，沿路10个靶标牌。全射。回小屋会出现气球，也射取种子
items.hintEn: The nearby dirt road makes a loop; along that loop are 10 signs with bullseye targets. Shoot them all. Back at the cabin, a balloon will appear, shoot it too for the seed.

items.hintCn: 石头底下。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Under a rock. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended

items.hintCn: 雪山岩石构造下隐藏的石头底下。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Under a rock hidden beneath the snowy hill formation. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚进坑里。巨石在东边坡上
items.hintEn: Roll the boulder into the hole. Boulders are uphill to the east.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把链上石头移进井里
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to move the chained rock into the well.

items.hintCn: 捡起东边石头，放进巨石圈缺失处
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock to the east of here and place it in the missing spot in the ring of boulders.

items.hintCn: 炸碎石块，捡起下面的
items.hintEn: Blow up the rocks here, then pick up the one under them.

items.hintCn: 射树上的橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn in the tree.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 跟随花径上桥支架往左
items.hintEn: Follow the flowers up the bridge support and to the left.

items.hintCn: 看标记东南方降一壁架找种子平台。赛跑爬上悬崖至圆环
items.hintEn: Look to the southeast of the marker, one ledge down, to find the seed platform. Race up the cliff to the circle.

items.hintCn: 跟随黄色花径。起点在标记东边树丛中间，稍曲折，出树丛又回到附近
items.hintEn: Follow the yellow flower trail. It begins east of the mark in the middle of a group of trees, and zigzags a little, going out of the circle of trees then returning nearby.

items.hintCn: 完成心形岩石构造
items.hintEn: Complete the heart shaped rock formation.

items.hintCn: 捡起大树顶上的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock on top of the large tree.

items.hintCn: 用北边波克布林营地旁的石头完成石圈。在木柱旁
items.hintEn: Complete the stone circle with a rock by the nearby Bokoblin camp to the north. It will be next to one of the wooden pillars.

items.hintCn: 完成石头图案。需要的石头就在坡下
items.hintEn: Complete the rock pattern. The rock you need is just downhill.

items.hintCn: 从周围小石阵搬三块石头放进大石阵
items.hintEn: Put three rocks in the big circular stone formation from the smaller rock formations around it.

items.hintCn: 捡起小壁架上的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the stone on the small ledge.

items.hintCn: 捡起这块石头，快到崖顶
items.hintEn: Pick up this rock, almost at the top of the cliff.

items.hintCn: 完成石头图案
items.hintEn: Complete the rock pattern.

items.hintCn: 完成这个石圈需要的石头在上方悬崖
items.hintEn: The rock needed to complete this stone circle is on the cliff above.

items.hintCn: 海滩上有个缺一处的石圈。找附近巨石（棕榈树旁），搬起放进缺失处
items.hintEn: On the beach is a ring of rocks with one spot missing. Find the nearby boulder (close to the palm tree), pick it up and drop it into the missing spot.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Stand next to the pinwheel, shoot the balloon. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 融化左边冰块露出树叶查看。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Melt the left piece of ice to reveal leaves to examine. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended.

items.hintCn: 从圈中心搬石头放到外圈缺失处
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock from the center of the circle and put it in the missing spot on the outer circle.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 炸大碎石堆，举起隐藏在下面的小石头
items.hintEn: Bomb the large pile of rocks, then lift up the small rock that was hidden underneath.

items.hintCn: 跟随绕小池塘一圈的黄色花径
items.hintEn: Follow the yellow flower trail in a loop around the little pond area.

items.hintCn: 移开大石头（用静止器击打），然后搬小石头
items.hintEn: Remove the large rock (use Stasis and hit it), then pick up the smaller.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射下三个气球靶
items.hintEn: Stand next to the pinwheel and then shoot down all three balloon targets.

items.hintCn: 精灵光点绕区域盘旋。抓住
items.hintEn: Fairy lights circle the area. Catch them.

items.hintCn: 力量之泉上方上层岩层，小丘上有块石头。举起克洛格出现给你种子
items.hintEn: Above the Spring of Power on an upper rock layer, a rock sits on top a small hill. Lift it and a Korok will appear to give you a seed.

items.hintCn: 从苹果过多的树上摘果使其和另外两棵匹配
items.hintEn: Remove apples from the tree with too many to match the other two.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图。方块在西边柱顶。拼图处需要耐寒等级1
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle. The block is on top of a pillar to the west. You'll need Level 1 cold resistance where the puzzle is.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把石头放进井里
items.hintEn: Use magnesis to put the rock in the well.

items.hintCn: 烧掉荆棘或飘过去，捡起石头
items.hintEn: Burn away the brambles or float over them, and pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 精灵光点绕区域盘旋。抓住
items.hintEn: Fairy lights circle the area. Catch them.

items.hintCn: 完成石三角
items.hintEn: Complete the rock triangle.

items.hintCn: 用附近石头补全圆圈
items.hintEn: Use the nearby rock to complete the circle.

items.hintCn: 融化大冰块
items.hintEn: Melt the large chunk of ice.

items.hintCn: 用附近石头补全圆圈
items.hintEn: Use the nearby rock to complete the circle.

items.hintCn: 用石头补全圆圈
items.hintEn: Use the rock to complete the circle.

items.hintCn: 使两个石图案匹配
items.hintEn: Make both rock patterns match.

items.hintCn: 射树里藏的气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon hiding in the tree.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把方块从水里抬出完成拼图
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to lift the block out of the water and complete the puzzle.

items.hintCn: 移开石板露出石头捡起
items.hintEn: Move the slab to reveal the rock to pick up.

items.hintCn: 击打树叶，然后捡起石头
items.hintEn: Hit the leaves, then pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 在睡莲圈旁造冰柱，然后跳入
items.hintEn: Create a cryonis pillar next to the circle of water lilies and then dive into it.

items.hintCn: 跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Dive into the circle of lilies.

items.hintCn: 这个赛跑种子平台在东南山脊线上。索·库菲神庙西边坡上峰顶。到平台后滑翔冲刺取种子
items.hintEn: The seed platform for this race is along the line of the ridge to the southeast. It's the peak just uphill to the west of the Soh Kofi Shrine. Once you reach the seed platform, glide and sprint to the end for your seed.

items.hintCn: 把石头扔进水中石圈
items.hintEn: Throw a rock into the circle of rocks in the water.

items.hintCn: 爬到树顶查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the tree and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 跳入海藻/植物圈
items.hintEn: Jump into the circle of seaweed/plants.

items.hintCn: 把石头搬到屋顶完成石三角。有难度，方法多种
items.hintEn: Get a rock to the roof, and complete the rock triangle. This can be difficult and there are multiple methods.

items.hintCn: 清理树叶然后举起小石头
items.hintEn: Clear away the leaves and then lift up the small rock.

items.hintCn: 跳下或跳入水中百合花圈
items.hintEn: Jump or dive into the ring of flower lilies in the water.

items.hintCn: 爬到这里峰顶举起小石头
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the peak here and lift the small rock.

items.hintCn: 举起这棵树旁小石头，就在通往山下隧道口边
items.hintEn: Lift the small rock next to this tree, right next to the opening that leads into the tunnel beneath the hill.

items.hintCn: 这个高原顶有3棵榴莲树。摘2颗榴莲使最西树和另外两棵一样
items.hintEn: At the top of this plateau are 3 durian trees. Pluck 2 Hearty Durians to make the west-most tree identical to the other 2 trees.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在崖底。爬上至圆环
items.hintEn: The seed platform is at the bottom of the cliff. Climb up to the ring.

items.hintCn: 瀑布半腰左右两个壁架。一个是磁力拼图，另一个有缺失方块。不要在瀑布上造冰（方块会倾斜使立方体掉落），磁力范围够长可到拼图架
items.hintEn: Halfway up the waterfall are two ledges to the left and the right. On one of them is a Magnesis puzzle; the other ledge contains the missing block. Refrain from using Cryonis on the waterfall, since the blocks will come out tilted and will make the cube fall; the range of Magnesis is long enough for the cube to reach the puzzle ledge.

items.hintCn: 爬到树顶站风车旁。出现三个气球。全射使克洛格出现。气球藏得很好，包括一个挂在树台边下方，仔细看
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the tree and stand near the pinwheel. Three balloons will appear. Shoot them all to make the Korok appear. These Balloons are well hidden, including one hanging just below the edge of the tree platform, so look around carefully.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 把石头扔进石圈。从左边壁架高度用造冰术更容易
items.hintEn: Throw a rock in the circle of rocks. Getting some height from the ledge to the left and using Cryonis makes it easier.

items.hintCn: 河上飘着气球。射它。贴近滑翔半空射可能有帮助，或直接像其他气球一样扔炸弹
items.hintEn: A balloon is floating above the river. Shoot it. Gliding close and using a mid-air shot might help, or just drop a bomb on it like you can for every other balloon

items.hintCn: 摧毁橡果。射箭最容易
items.hintEn: Destroy the acorn. Shooting it with an arrow is easiest.

items.hintCn: 匹配树上苹果图案
items.hintEn: Match the apple pattern on the tree.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the Fairy Lights.

items.hintCn: 在岩壁约半腰找突出小石架带块石头
items.hintEn: Look for a small ledge jutting out of the rock face with a rock on it approximately halfway up the wall.

items.hintCn: 跟随稍南开始的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the trail of flowers starting from slightly south.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock.

items.hintCn: 花径从西边坡下开始，需要爬一段才能到种子
items.hintEn: The flower trail starts downhill to the west, and will involve some climbing to reach the seed.

items.hintCn: 在卓拉领地顶鱼雕像尾鳍近最高点处查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: In the tail fin of the fish statue on top of Zora's Domain, almost the very highest point, examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 用静止器或章鱼气球移开大平石，然后捡起下面石头
items.hintEn: Move the large, flat rock with Stasis or an Octo Balloon, then pick up the rock underneath it.

items.hintCn: 解悬崖壁磁力拼图（采石场最低层）。金属方块在南边附近坡顶
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis puzzle on the cliff wall (at the lowest level of the quarry). The metal block is on top of the nearby rising to the south.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 从下方地面看上方悬岩射孤气球
items.hintEn: From the ground below, look up into the overhanging rock and shoot the lone balloon.

items.hintCn: 爬上来捡起石头
items.hintEn: Climb up here and pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 旗杆顶上
items.hintEn: On top of a flagpole.

items.hintCn: 过河找巨石。用磁力搬大金属巨石到坑
items.hintEn: Look across the river for a boulder. Use Magnesis to carry the large metal boulder to the hole.

items.hintCn: 跟随花径上山
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail up the hill.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 站纸风车旁树桩上射西南两树间抛起的橡果
items.hintEn: Stand on the tree stump by the paper windmill and shoot the acorn that is being thrown between two trees to southwest.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 这个留了线索。炸巨石捡起下面石头
items.hintEn: This one left a clue for you. Bomb the boulders and pick up the rock under them.

items.hintCn: 炸碎石堆捡起下面石头
items.hintEn: Bomb the rock pile and pick up the rock underneath.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 花径从东边开始，跟随它穿过隧道向西
items.hintEn: The flower trail starts to the east, follow it through the tunnel to the west.

items.hintCn: 清理树叶捡起下面石头
items.hintEn: Clear the leaves, pick up the rock beneath.

items.hintCn: 用海滩另一端的石头完成石圈
items.hintEn: Complete the rock circle using the rock at the other end of the beach.

items.hintCn: 炸巨石捡起下面石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the boulders, pick up the rock underneath.

items.hintCn: 树顶石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock on top of a tree.

items.hintCn: 捡起这块石头
items.hintEn: Pick up this rock.

items.hintCn: 通过摘苹果使三棵树相同
items.hintEn: Make the three trees identical by picking apples.

items.hintCn: 用章鱼气球举起大石头，然后自己捡小石头
items.hintEn: Lift the big rock with an Octo Balloon, then pick up the small rock yourself.

items.hintCn: 射大石拱里的气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon inside the big stone arch.

items.hintCn: 这个花径从西边崖上树丛开始
items.hintEn: The flower trail for this starts up the cliffs to the west, in the grove.

items.hintCn: 在南偏西种子平台开始赛跑。限时赛跑至崖边
items.hintEn: Start the race on the seed platform to the south and slightly west. Race up to the cliff edge before the time runs out.

items.hintCn: 搬开大巨石然后举起隐藏下面的小石头
items.hintEn: Get the large boulder out of the way and then lift up the small rock hidden underneath it.

items.hintCn: 捡起空心树桩里的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock in the hollow stump.

items.hintCn: 站风车旁草地上射三个气球
items.hintEn: Stand on the patch of grass near the pinwheel, and shoot the three balloons.

items.hintCn: 移动门捡起石头
items.hintEn: Move the door, pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 在东岸捡附近石头扔进河里石圈
items.hintEn: Pick up a nearby rock on the eastern bank and throw it into the stone circle in the river.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 用瀑布后磁力方块完成崖边拼图。需要造冰术到达拼图处
items.hintEn: Use the magnesis block behind the waterfall to complete the cliffside puzzle. Cryonis will be required to reach the puzzle.

items.hintCn: 抓住绕区域盘旋的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights as they circle around the area.

items.hintCn: 爬上废墟顶查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb on top of the destroyed building and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 移开树叶露出石头。捡起
items.hintEn: Move the leaves to uncover a rock. Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Dive into the circle of lilies.

items.hintCn: 爬上肋骨到风车查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb up the rib to the pinwheel and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 用附近石头完成石圈
items.hintEn: Complete the stone circle using nearby rocks.

items.hintCn: 射石桥缝隙里的气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon in the rock bridge cleft.

items.hintCn: 站附近种子平台然后赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: Stand on the nearby seed platform and then race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 查看石桥缝隙里的精灵光点
items.hintEn: Examine the fairy lights in the cleft in the rock bridge.

items.hintCn: 这个赛跑种子平台在东北崖顶。赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: The seed platform for this race is at the top of the cliff to the northeast. Race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 这条花径从正西山底开始，需要直爬。带满体力（3条满不够需要补）
items.hintEn: This flower trail starts directly west, at the bottom of the cliff, and requires you to climb straight up. Bring lots of stamina 3 full bars isn't enough will need to replenish.

items.hintCn: 把崖顶巨石推进底部坑里
items.hintEn: Push the boulders at the top of the cliff into the hole at the bottom.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在西北壁架上。赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: The seed platform is on the ledge to the northwest. Race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 花径从隧道内开始，沿北边洞口向上
items.hintEn: The flower trail starts inside the tunnel, then works its way up the northern cave entrance.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把石头放进井里
items.hintEn: Put the rock in the well using Magnesis.

items.hintCn: 旅馆顶上有3根棕榈树干。绕它们追黄色花径
items.hintEn: On top of the inn, there are 3 palm tree trunks. Climb around these chasing the yellow flower trail.

items.hintCn: 从棕榈果间射掉苹果
items.hintEn: Remove the apple from between the palm fruits, such as by shooting it.

items.hintCn: 从西边树摘2颗榴莲使三棵树匹配
items.hintEn: Remove two Hearty Durian from the western tree so that all three trees match.

items.hintCn: 在雕像下叶子上放香蕉
items.hintEn: Place Mighty Bananas on the leaf below the statue.

items.hintCn: 烧掉驿站上方马结构用树叶做的胡子
items.hintEn: Burn the goatee made out of leaves of the Horse structure above the stables.

items.hintCn: 从雕像眼睛里取出夜光石
items.hintEn: Remove the Luminous Stone from the eye of the statue.

items.hintCn: 举起这里壁架上的小石头
items.hintEn: Lift up the small rock found on top of the ledge here.

items.hintCn: 这个克洛格石图案是大螺旋。从外数第二行缺一块，用附近石头补全
items.hintEn: This Korok's rock pattern is in the shape of a large spiral. On the second line from the outside is a missing rock, simply complete the pattern with the rock found nearby.

items.hintCn: 这个赛跑从西南更高柱子开始
items.hintEn: This race begins at the even taller pillar to the southwest.

items.hintCn: 用静止器或章鱼气球移开石板（区域有几只八爪怪），然后捡起石头
items.hintEn: Remove the slab using Stasis or an Octo Balloon since there's several octoroks in the area, then pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 把附近石头扔进池塘石圈。造冰术可能有帮助
items.hintEn: Throw a nearby rock into the ring of stones in the pond. Cryonis might help.

items.hintCn: 跟随桥对面开始的黄色花径
items.hintEn: Follow the yellow flower trail that starts just on the opposite side of the bridge.

items.hintCn: 射棕榈树顶藏的气球。爬上东边壁架最容易发现
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon hidden in the top of the palm tree. It is easiest to spot if you climb up the ledge to the east.

items.hintCn: 跳入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Dive into the ring of lilies.

items.hintCn: 这个洞上方高崖有三块巨石。推一块下崖进洞
items.hintEn: High on the cliff above this hole are three boulders. Push one of them off the cliff and into the hole.

items.hintCn: 北边壁架捡石头移到石圈补全
items.hintEn: Pick up a rock to the north just up the ledge and move it to complete the stone circle.

items.hintCn: 跳入水中百合花圈
items.hintEn: Dive into the ring of flower lilies in the water.

items.hintCn: 举起这山顶小石头
items.hintEn: Lift up the small rock at the top of this mountain.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 跳入海藻圈露出克洛格
items.hintEn: Jump into the ring of seaweed to reveal a Korok.

items.hintCn: 爬到蘑菇形柱顶捡起石头
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the mushroom shaped pillar and pick up the rock at the top.

items.hintCn: 炸墙举起隐藏石头
items.hintEn: Bomb the wall and lift the hidden rock.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 爬棕榈树查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb the palm tree and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 从崖顶降一崖层找石头捡起
items.hintEn: Drop one cliff level down from the top of the cliff to find a rock to pick up.

items.hintCn: 这个很难看到。金属方块水下小岛旁，只能从特定角度看到（看箭头指处下方）。然后搬到崖上方块拼图，拼图在崖北側难找
items.hintEn: This one is very hard to see. The metal cube is underwater next to the islands, but can only be seen from certain angles (look down where the arrow is in the picture). Then take it to the block puzzle on the cliff, which can be hard to spot. It's on the north side of the cliff.

items.hintCn: 炸山坡角落墙然后举起露出的石头
items.hintEn: Bomb the wall in the corner of the hillside then lift the revealed rock.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚进坑里
items.hintEn: Roll the boulder into the hole.

items.hintCn: 射橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 射气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon.

items.hintCn: 移动石板，捡起下面石头
items.hintEn: Move the slab, and pick up the rock under it.

items.hintCn: 沿桥下到第一排窗户。窄壁架上捡树枝
items.hintEn: Climb down the bridge to the first set of windows. Pick up the tree branch on the narrow ledge.

items.hintCn: 查看树顶精灵光点。雷暴时别试，雷击会劈倒树
items.hintEn: Examine the fairy lights at the top of the tree. Refrain from attempting it during a thunderstorm, since lightning will strike and take the tree down.

items.hintCn: 解开磁力方块拼图。方块在附近水里
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle. The block is in the water nearby.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 站西岸种子平台然后赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: Step on the seed platform on the coast to the west and then race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 用磁力移动金属方块到瀑布对岸。在瀑布上造冰术到达上方方块拼图
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis on the metal cube and bring it to the other side of the waterfall. Use Cryonis on the waterfall to reach the box puzzle above.

items.hintCn: 用磁力把链上石头移进树桩
items.hintEn: Use Magnesis to move the chained rock into the stump.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图。方块在附近树上
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle. The block is in the nearby tree.

items.hintCn: 这里有两个精灵光点在飞舞。两个都抓可得两个种子
items.hintEn: There are two fairy lights dancing around here. Catch them both for two seeds.

items.hintCn: 举起山顶石头
items.hintEn: Lift stone at the top of the hill.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel, shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚进坑里
items.hintEn: Roll the boulder into the hole.

items.hintCn: 炸山腰可破墙，然后举起露出的石头
items.hintEn: Bomb the nearby breakable wall in the mountainside, then lift the revealed stone.

items.hintCn: 爬树举起小石头
items.hintEn: Climb up the tree and lift the small rock.

items.hintCn: 把巨石从柱子搬到角落，匹配雕像周围另外三个
items.hintEn: Get the boulder off the pillar and to the corner, matching the other three surrounding the statue.

items.hintCn: 举起小瀑布上方石头
items.hintEn: Lift the stone above the small waterfall.

items.hintCn: 与绕湖漂浮的精灵光点互动
items.hintEn: Interact with the fairy lights floating around the lake.

items.hintCn: 与绕区域漂浮的精灵光点互动
items.hintEn: Interact with the fairy lights floating around the area.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 在焦油坑小岛上完成石三角。砍树做桥
items.hintEn: Complete the rock triangle on the island in the tar pit. Knock down a tree to make a bridge.

items.hintCn: 北偏西北可见种子平台。赛跑至圆环取种子
items.hintEn: The seed platform is visible to the north-northwest. Race to the ring for the seed.

items.hintCn: 炸中间组巨石，然后捡起石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the middle set of boulders, and then pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 炸碎巨石，举起隐藏下面的小石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the boulders, then lift up the small rock that was hidden beneath them.

items.hintCn: 射气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon.

items.hintCn: 射空心原木末端藏的橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn hiding inside the end of the hollowed out log.

items.hintCn: 爬孤树到顶查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb the lone tree to the very top and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 射高树悬挂的小橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the small acorn hanging from the tall tree.

items.hintCn: 解开磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel, shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 爬树查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb the tree and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 射石桥下方气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon underneath the rock bridge.

items.hintCn: 捡起崖顶第一壁架上的石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock on the first ledge from the top of the cliff.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 北边不远木平台上有种子平台。赛跑至圆环取种子
items.hintEn: Just to the north is a seed platform on a wooden platform. Race to the ring for the seed.

items.hintCn: 到神庙后悬崖最西端，爬4层悬崖，然后捡起石头
items.hintEn: Go to the westernmost part of the cliff behind the shrine, climb up 4 cliffs, then pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 爬树，举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the tree, lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 解崖顶附近磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the Magnesis Block puzzle near the top of the cliff.

items.hintCn: 射树上气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon in the tree.

items.hintCn: 爬上种子平台，然后快速到圆环
items.hintEn: Climb up to the seed platform, and then get to the ring, quick.

items.hintCn: 爬到肋骨结构最高点查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb to the highest point of the rib structure and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 爬到肋骨结构最高点查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb to the highest point of the rib structure and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 完成石圈。要用的石头在崖壁角落
items.hintEn: Complete the rock circle. The rock to use is in a corner of the cliff wall.

items.hintCn: 跟随花径沿墙爬上上方悬崖
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail up the wall to the cliff above.

items.hintCn: 给供碗供奉香蕉
items.hintEn: Offer a Mighty Banana to the offering bowl.

items.hintCn: 给两个供碗供奉香蕉
items.hintEn: Offer Mighty Bananas to the two offering bowls.

items.hintCn: 给三个供碗供奉香蕉
items.hintEn: Offer Mighty Bananas to the three offering bowls.

items.hintCn: 给四个供碗供奉香蕉
items.hintEn: Offer Mighty Bananas to the four offering bowls.

items.hintCn: 给五个供碗供奉香蕉
items.hintEn: Offer Mighty Bananas to the five offering bowls.

items.hintCn: 滚...不，捡起雪球放进坑里
items.hintEn: Roll the...No, wait, pick up the snowball and place it in the hole.

items.hintCn: 这个磁力拼图比多数分散。答案在西墙，拼图在东，方块在中间
items.hintEn: This Magnesis puzzle is more spread out than most. Solution is on the west wall, puzzle on the east, and block's in the middle.

items.hintCn: 在石圈东边找石头。沿窄崖径走补全图案
items.hintEn: Find a rock just to the east of the rock circle. Walk along the narrow cliff path to complete the pattern.

items.hintCn: 这是由3块石头组成的石圈，除一块大石放错了。归位
items.hintEn: This is a rock circle made up of pieces of 3 rocks each, except for a large rock out of place. Put it in place.

items.hintCn: 在这山段顶举起小石头
items.hintEn: At the top of this section of the mountain, lift up the small rock.

items.hintCn: 山侧壁架上的石圈不完整。从稍高壁架搬石头到圈补全。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: A circle of rocks on this ledge on the side of the mountain is incomplete. Grab the rock from the ledge slightly higher up and bring it down to the ring and complete the circle of rocks. Level 2 Cold Resistance recommended

items.hintCn: 融化最靠边的冰块
items.hintEn: Melt the chunk of ice that's closest to the edge.

items.hintCn: 爬树查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Climb the tree and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 完成石头图案
items.hintEn: Complete the rock pattern.

items.hintCn: 完成磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Complete the magnetic block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 炸石墙捡起后面石头
items.hintEn: Bomb the rock wall and pick up the rock behind it.

items.hintCn: 爬进骷髅朝北眼窝，烧或炸树叶，然后捡起石头
items.hintEn: Climb inside of the skeleton's north-facing eye socket, burn or bomb the leaves, then pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 用附近石头完成石圈（往人马里走东边灌木丛里，静止器辅助可见）
items.hintEn: Complete the stone circle using a nearby rock (which is in a clump of bushes to the east as you head to the Lynel.  Stasis can help you see it.).

items.hintCn: 完成磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Finish the magnetic block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 用附近石头完成石头图案
items.hintEn: Finish the rock pattern with a nearby rock.

items.hintCn: 跳入瀑布底睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Dive into the circle of lilies at the bottom of the waterfall.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock.

items.hintCn: 举起围神庙结构顶上的石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock on top of the structure surrounding the shrine.

items.hintCn: 射上方悬崖下的气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon underneath the upper cliff.

items.hintCn: 完成遗迹里磁力方块拼图
items.hintEn: Complete the magnetic block puzzle in the ruins.

items.hintCn: 每个雕像前放一颗鸟蛋
items.hintEn: Place a Bird Egg in front of each statue.

items.hintCn: 举起竖井半腰石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock found halfway down the shaft.

items.hintCn: 海拉鲁城堡门上有块石头。举起
items.hintEn: On top of the gate to Hyrule Castle is a rock. Lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 跟随护城河南侧桥下开始的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail starting under the bridge on the southern side of the moat.

items.hintCn: 去掉树叶捡起下面石头
items.hintEn: Get rid of the leaves and pick up the rock underneath.

items.hintCn: 融化冰块查看闪光树叶。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Thaw the ice block and examine the glittering leaves. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended

items.hintCn: 神庙顶上。可炸巨石后石头底下
items.hintEn: On top of the temple. Under a rock behind the bombable boulders.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock.

items.hintCn: 骑马跳三个栅栏。也可以用摩托 zero jump
items.hintEn: Jump the three fences while riding. This can also be done with the Master Cycle Zero using the Zero Jump

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 清理苹果过多树上的苹果使其和其他一样多
items.hintEn: Clear the apples on the tree with too many to have the same amount as the others.

items.hintCn: 完成石方
items.hintEn: Complete the rock square.

items.hintCn: 移开石板，然后捡起石头
items.hintEn: Remove the rock slab, then pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 敲落巨石然后捡小石头
items.hintEn: Knock the boulder off, then pick up the little rock.

items.hintCn: 看石桥下找带石头小壁架。捡起石头露出克洛格
items.hintEn: Look under the rock bridge to find a small ledge with a rock on it. Pick up the rock to reveal the Korok.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 摧毁树洞里橡果
items.hintEn: Destroy the acorn inside the hollow of the tree log.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在北边，水开始处西边不远，俯瞰瀑布最高点。赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: The seed platform is to the north, just west of where the water begins, at the highest point overlooking the falls. Race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 射水边气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon down by the water.

items.hintCn: 摧毁树洞里橡果
items.hintEn: Destroy the acorn in the hollow of the tree log.

items.hintCn: 位于比附近种子更高壁架。这里有两个方块和树叶堆。拨树叶捡石头
items.hintEn: Located on a higher ledge than the nearby seed. There are two blocks and pile of leaves here. Disturb the leaves and pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 位于比附近种子更低壁架。用磁力移门露出石头捡起
items.hintEn: Located on a lower ledge than the nearby seed. Move the door with Magnesis to uncover a rock to pick up.

items.hintCn: 从带炮南壁架跳下找树叶堆。拨树叶捡石头
items.hintEn: Drop down from the southern ledge with the cannons to find a pile of leaves. Disturb the leaves and pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 桥下移动石板然后捡起石头
items.hintEn: Under the bridge, move the rock slab, then pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 炸岩壁举起隐藏后面小石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the rock wall and lift up the small rock that was hidden behind it.

items.hintCn: 炸巨石举起下面石头
items.hintEn: Blow up the boulders, lift up the rock underneath.

items.hintCn: 爬高松树查看发光树叶找克洛格
items.hintEn: Climb a tall pine tree and examine the glowing leaves to find the Korok.

items.hintCn: 站树顶风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand next to the pinwheel atop the tree and shoot the balloons.

items.hintCn: 一个隐形克洛格绕区域跑。互动收集种子
items.hintEn: An invisible Korok will be running around the area. Interact with it and collect the Korok seed.

items.hintCn: 清理树叶捡起石头找克洛格
items.hintEn: Clear the leaves and pick up the rock to find the Korok.

items.hintCn: 用斩草武器拨树叶然后举起隐藏下面小石头
items.hintEn: Disturb the leaves with a bladed weapon then lift up the small rock hidden underneath them.

items.hintCn: 种子平台在骷髅上。赛跑至圆环
items.hintEn: The seed platform is on the skull. Race to the ring.

items.hintCn: 在可破墙用炸弹然后举起石头
items.hintEn: Use a bomb on the breakable wall then lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 上坡找种子平台。及时赛跑至目标露出克洛格
items.hintEn: Find the seed platform up hill. Race in time to the target to reveal the Korok.

items.hintCn: 把其中一块石头扔进石圈
items.hintEn: Throw one of the rocks into the rock circle.

items.hintCn: 完成磁力方块拼图。金属方块在峡谷底东缘，模板在池塘东北，拼图在中心岛
items.hintEn: Complete the Magnesis cube puzzle. The metal cube is located on the eastern edge of the canyon floor, the template on the northeast side of the pond, and the puzzle is found on the island center.

items.hintCn: 摧毁树洞里橡果
items.hintEn: Destroy the acorn in the hollow of the log.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle.

items.hintCn: 举起喷泉顶上石头
items.hintEn: Lift the stone on top of the fountain.

items.hintCn: 站风车树桩上射绕附近树盘旋3个靶子
items.hintEn: Stand on the stump with the pinwheel and shoot the 3 targets that are circling the nearby trees.

items.hintCn: 举起枯树中心石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock in the center of the dead trees.

items.hintCn: 射空心树洞里橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn inside the hollow tree log.

items.hintCn: 跳入/跳入/跌入睡莲圈
items.hintEn: Dive/jump/fall into the circle of water lilies.

items.hintCn: 可碎石后石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock behind some destructible boulders.

items.hintCn: 捡起最北柱上石头移到柱上缘使其和其他柱石头摆放匹配
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock on the northernmost pillar and move it to the upper edge of the pillar so it matches the rock placement on the other pillars.

items.hintCn: 树叶堆下石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock under a pile of leaves.

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚进下方熔岩池
items.hintEn: Roll a boulder into the lava pond below.

items.hintCn: 用磁力完成拼图
items.hintEn: Complete the puzzle using Magnesis.

items.hintCn: 搬石头过浅水到石圈扔进
items.hintEn: Carry a rock through the shallow water to the rock circle and throw it in.

items.hintCn: 跟随花径。起点在思库达秘泉西北偏西半崖。沿崖壁向南
items.hintEn: Follow the flower trail. It starts west-northwest of Sturnida Secret Hot Spring, halfway up the cliff. The trail leads south along the cliff face.

items.hintCn: 花径从东南不远处崖下开始。跟随爬上悬崖
items.hintEn: The flower trail starts a short distance southeast and down the cliff. Follow it up the cliff.

items.hintCn: 爬枯树与精灵光点互动
items.hintEn: Climb the dead tree and interact with the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 查看枯树顶精灵光点。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Examine the fairy lights on the top of the dead tree. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock.

items.hintCn: 用附近石头完成石头图案
items.hintEn: Complete the rock pattern using a nearby rock.

items.hintCn: 爬上东北最高柱顶捡石头
items.hintEn: Climb up the tallest pillar in the northeast section and pick up the rock at the top.

items.hintCn: 跳入桥旁水中花圈
items.hintEn: Dive into the ring of flowers in the water next to the bridge.

items.hintCn: 爬到树顶查看旋转树叶
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the tree and examine the swirling leaves.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射橡果。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the acorn. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended

items.hintCn: 融化冰块查看精灵光点。建议耐寒等级2
items.hintEn: Thaw the ice block and examine the fairy lights. Cold Resistance Level 2 recommended

items.hintCn: 射高崖下悬挂气球
items.hintEn: Shoot the balloon that hangs high up under a cliff.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up a rock.

items.hintCn: 融化冰块查看闪光树叶
items.hintEn: Thaw the ice block and examine the glittering leaves.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock.

items.hintCn: 查看枯树顶闪光树叶
items.hintEn: Examine the glittering leaves at the top of the dead tree.

items.hintCn: 查看树顶精灵光点
items.hintEn: Examine the fairy lights at the top of the tree.

items.hintCn: 跟随路北稍东开始的花径
items.hintEn: Follow the trail of flowers that starts next to the road to the north.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock.

items.hintCn: 雪球可搬。放一个到下面坑里
items.hintEn: Snow boulders can be carried. Put one in the hole below.

items.hintCn: 摧毁树洞里橡果
items.hintEn: Destroy the acorn in the hollow in the tree log.

items.hintCn: 石头底下
items.hintEn: Under a rock.

items.hintCn: 抓住精灵光点
items.hintEn: Catch the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 用附近石头完成石圈
items.hintEn: Use the nearby rock to complete the rock circle.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 破墙然后举起石头
items.hintEn: Break the wall, then lift the stone.

items.hintCn: 在骷髅里找风车，看眼睛外找目标气球。射箭露出克洛格
items.hintEn: Find the pinwheel inside the skull, look outside the eye to find the target balloon. Shoot it with an arrow to reveal the Korok.

items.hintCn: 完成石圈
items.hintEn: Complete the stone circle.

items.hintCn: 破墙举起石头
items.hintEn: Break the wall, lift the stone.

items.hintCn: 爬柱捡起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the pillar, pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 用上方石头完成下方石圈
items.hintEn: Use the rock above to complete the stone circle below.

items.hintCn: 举起石头露出克洛格
items.hintEn: Lift the rock to reveal the Korok.

items.hintCn: 举起岩石雕塑腋窝下石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock that's located under the rock sculpture's armpit.

items.hintCn: 从城入口看左上。爬进西南哥隆岩石结构嘴里查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: From the city entrance, look up and to the left. Climb into the mouth of the southwest goron in the rock structure, and examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 查看石肋骨顶上精灵光点
items.hintEn: Examine the fairy lights on top of the stone ribcage.

items.hintCn: 射树洞里橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn in the hole in the tree.

items.hintCn: 捡起石头
items.hintEn: Pick up the rock.

items.hintCn: 把巨石滚到坑里
items.hintEn: Roll the boulder to the hole.

items.hintCn: 射通往海拉鲁城堡门桥下凹处藏的橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn hidden in the alcove under the bridge to the gate to Hyrule Castle.

items.hintCn: 从西偏南平台赛跑至终点。用上升气流和滑翔伞快速升高
items.hintEn: Race to the finish from the platform to the west-southwest. Use the updraft and your paraglider to gain height quickly.

items.hintCn: 射石纹章露出克洛格
items.hintEn: Shoot the stone Coat of Arms to reveal the Korok.

items.hintCn: 爬上平台举起石头
items.hintEn: Climb the platform and lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 射树洞里橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn in the hole in the tree.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock up.

items.hintCn: 与精灵光点互动
items.hintEn: Interact with the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 射树干里橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn in the tree trunk.

items.hintCn: 射原木里橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn in the log.

items.hintCn: 射空心原木里橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn in the hollow log.

items.hintCn: 炸高崖边可破墙然后举起石头
items.hintEn: Bomb the breakable wall high up on the cliffside, then lift the stone.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the stone.

items.hintCn: 进入东通道。在岩石巨人房间前，沿墙有冰块。融化最大冰块然后查看精灵光点
items.hintEn: Enter the East Passage. Just before the room with the Talus, you find blocks of ice along a wall. Melt the largest ice block, then examine the fairy lights.

items.hintCn: 这个壁架就在进城堡前路最后弯道下方。炸可破墙然后举起石头
items.hintEn: This ledge is just below the last curve in the path before it enters the castle. Bomb the breakable wall, then lift the stone.

items.hintCn: 爬到第一门屋上方尖塔顶
items.hintEn: Climb to the top of the spire above the First Gatehouse.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 把石头扔进水中石圈
items.hintEn: Throw a rock into the ring of stones in the water.

items.hintCn: 举起石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock.

items.hintCn: 解开方块拼图。一半在附近水下
items.hintEn: Solve the block puzzle. Half of it is underwater nearby.

items.hintCn: 在水上方岩石壁架上炸可破墙然后举起石头
items.hintEn: On a rock ledge just above the water, bomb the breakable wall, then lift the stone.

items.hintCn: 举起桥下石头
items.hintEn: Lift the rock under the bridge.

items.hintCn: 在第三棵树摘苹果使其和另外两棵匹配
items.hintEn: Pick apples on the third tree to make it match the other two.

items.hintCn: 射橡果
items.hintEn: Shoot the acorn.

items.hintCn: 站在风车旁射气球
items.hintEn: Stand near the pinwheel and shoot the balloon.
